verdict.rationale: The GitHub README explicitly lists deep crawl crash recovery through a `resume_state` parameter that continues from a saved checkpoint. It also lists `on_state_change` callbacks for persisting state during long-running crawls, which applies to the documented BFS deep-crawl mode. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on checkpoint format and storage, details on resume semantics (dedup, partial results), and independent or hands-on corroboration that recovery works after a real crash.
